_about: Single source of truth for project names, one-line descriptions, authorship, stacks, numbers and media. The homepage gallery, the Projects page, every repository README header and the GitHub profile README take their wording from here. Numbers carry their source. Last checked 2026-11-13.

projects.name: Clinic Inbox Checks
projects.one_liner: A simulated clinic inbox for testing AI agents. The checks read the server's record, not the agent's report.
projects.what_i_did: Designed the simulated inbox, the ten-rule policy and the two measurements; recorded 60 runs and traced every flagged run to its cause.
projects.who_wrote_the_code: Coding agents wrote most of the code. The idea, what to build and test, and the reading of the results are mine. The checks written in advance were written by a coding agent and reviewed by me.

numbers.text: In the two tasks where a save fails silently while the screen says saved, the agent reopened the message and saved again in all 10 runs
Checks written in advance and checks a second model wrote agreed on 54 of 60 runs; all 6 flags traced to 2 faulty checks, one of each kind

projects.limits: One agent model and synthetic data; the numbers describe this pilot only.

site.summary_zh: 一个模拟的诊所收件箱，用来测试 AI agent。检查读的是服务器的记录，不读 agent 自己的汇报。
note: Replay of a recorded run in the simulator · synthetic patients and rules
在模拟器里重放一次录制的运行 · 病人和规则都是合成的
features: A save that silently fails
悄悄失败的保存
In two tasks the screen says "Routing saved" while the save is lost. In all 10 runs that hit it, the agent reopened the message and saved again.
有两个任务里，界面显示 "Routing saved"，保存其实丢了。碰到它的 10 次运行，agent 全部重新打开消息又存了一次。
Checks that read the record
检查读的是记录
The checks read the server's event log and stored state, never the agent's account of its work. Coding agents wrote most of the code; the idea and what to test are mine.
检查只读服务器的事件日志和存储状态，不读 agent 对自己做了什么的说法。想法、做什么、测什么由我决定；大部分代码由 coding agent 写。
Every flag was a wrong check
每次标记都是检查错了
Of 60 runs, six were flagged, and each flag came from a wrong check: one written in advance, one generated by a second model.
60 次运行里有 6 次被标记，每一次都是检查本身写错了：一条事先写好的，一条由另一个模型生成的。

projects.name: Auto-Load-off-Test
projects.one_liner: A Python/Tkinter bench program that steps a signal generator, captures each response on an oscilloscope, and computes gain and phase.
projects.what_i_did: Sole developer of the 2025 program, built at Intalight to replace the hand-edited scripts behind each frequency-response measurement. It reads back key instrument settings and warns when one is out of tolerance.
projects.who_wrote_the_code: The 2025 version (tag v0.1.0) I wrote by hand, with only light code completion; part of the instrument-driver file came from others. The 2026 restructuring on main was written by a coding agent to my specification.

numbers.text: 3,100+ lines I wrote for the 2025 version
Tested by the company's test engineers on instruments before its engineers used it; open-sourced with the company's permission

projects.limits: The automated tests and the demo use simulated data; the 2026 version has not been validated on live instruments in this repository.

site.summary_zh: 一个 Python/Tkinter 测试台程序：控制信号发生器扫频，用示波器采下每个响应，再算出增益和相位。
note: Real operator console replaying a simulated 72-point fixture, then the report it writes · no hardware
真实操作界面回放 72 点模拟数据，再看它生成的报告 · 没有接仪器
features: One program instead of edited scripts
一个程序代替手改脚本
Written to replace the hand-edited Python scripts behind frequency-response measurements; saves MAT, TXT and CSV results with plots.
为替代硬件组做频响测量时常常要手改的 Python 脚本而写，结果存成 MAT、TXT、CSV 和图表。
Check what the instruments did
核对仪器实际设成了什么
The 2025 version reads back the generator frequency and amplitude and the oscilloscope range and offset, and warns when one is outside a tolerance.
2025 版会读回示波器的量程、偏置和信号源的幅度、频率，超出容差就提示。
Restructured in 2026
2026 年重构
A coding agent rewrote it to my specification: checks before settings are sent, an event log, timeouts and 168 tests that run without hardware. It no longer reads back range and offset.
coding agent 按我的要求重写：加了发送前的参数检查、事件日志、超时处理和 168 个不接硬件的测试；量程和偏置不再读回比对。

projects.name: Tiny Stories
projects.subtitle: RPG Demo
projects.one_liner: An interactive story system: one premise becomes a 12-turn story of choices or free actions, with saved sessions, replay, and a reviewer view of each turn's state.
projects.what_i_did: Built the story runtime around story state, free-text intent mapping, fallbacks, budgets and character behavior; an advisor can read a run but cannot change the story.
projects.limits: A portfolio case study, not a validated consumer product; demand and repeat play are unproven.

site.summary_zh: 一个互动故事系统：一个故事前提变成 12 回合的故事，每回合可以选选项或自由行动，能存档、回放，还有一个查看每回合状态的审阅视图。
features: More than a chatbot
不只是聊天机器人
One premise becomes a cast, a player role with a private objective and an opening scene, then a 12-turn story of choices and free-form actions.
一个故事前提会生成角色、带私人目标的玩家身份和开场，然后进入 12 回合的故事，可以选选项，也可以自由行动。
State that is kept
状态会保存下来
Story templates, sessions and messages are stored in SQLite behind typed API contracts, so a finished run can be replayed.
故事模板、会话和消息通过类型化接口存进 SQLite，结束的一局可以回放。
A run you can inspect
每一局都能检查
A reviewer view shows the state behind each turn. The advisor can read the run but cannot change the story. Built with coding agents.
reviewer 视图展示每一回合背后的状态；顾问能读这一局，但不能改动故事。整个项目用 coding agent 构建。

projects.name: batch.
projects.one_liner: An interactive 3D lesson about batching, waiting, and server scheduling.
projects.who_wrote_the_code: TODO(owner): confirm. Commit history shows coding-agent co-authorship.
projects.limits: A teaching model with an illustrative timing rule, not a benchmark of a GPU or language model.

site.summary_zh: 一节关于批处理、等待和服务器调度的 3D 互动课。
note: Teaching model with an illustrative timing rule · not a benchmark
教学模型，计时规则是示意 · 不是基准测试
features: Start now or wait
马上开始，还是等一等
Follow request A into a server and choose whether it starts at once or waits briefly so others can join its round.
跟着请求 A 进入服务器，选择让它马上开始，还是稍等一下，让别的请求加入同一轮。
Same arrivals, two strategies
同样的到达，两种策略
Replay exactly the same requests under the other strategy and compare your own finish time with the time to finish the whole group.
用另一种策略重放完全相同的请求，比较你自己的完成时间和整组的完成时间。
A model you can read
看得懂的模型
Each round takes 1900 + 300 × batch size simulated milliseconds, an illustrative rule that makes fixed overhead visible. It runs in the browser with no AI service.
每一轮计算耗时 1900 + 300 × 批大小 个模拟毫秒，这是为了让固定开销看得见的示意规则。整节课在浏览器里运行，不调用 AI 服务。

not_on_site.CalendarDIFF: Kept public with an honest README; the owner considers it a failed product.
